notes.title: Thank You For Playing Our Demo!
notes.content:
The Academy is pleased with your efforts! Even after our doors have closed, your impact echoes through the underworld...

Thank you to everyone who joined Avelin's fight during the Carnival of Chaos! Watching you wield the state-of-the-undead-art weapons of death, master brutal combat, and fight to return to the living has been incredible.

Every death, every victory, every piece of feedback you provide is so very appreciated, and thank you for being a part of our journey! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648502/85fce2e82e8b8fc57252bdd99783cf6c4b216d33.jpg

Every death, every victory, every piece of feedback you provide shapes Avelin's destiny. Thank you for being a part of our journey and stay tuned for more information!
